newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Foreigners buy 10.8 bln rand SAfrica gilts this yr.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners buy 10.8 bln rand SAfrica gilts this yr.

text.p: Foreigners continued to pile into the South African bond market in April, buying nearly five billion rand's worth of domestic gilts, latest Bond Exchange statistics shows.

The data shows foreigners were net buyers of 4.68 billion rand's worth of bonds, up from 2.872 billion rand in March, which brought total net foreign purchases so far this year to 10.767 billion rand's worth.
In the same period a year ago, foreigners were net sellers of 2.231 billion rand's worth and on a cumulative basis, were net buyers of just 125 million rand's worth.
Offshore trades directly between non-residents stood at 53.45 billion rand from 59.52 billion rand in March, bringing cumulative total trades to 189.75 billion rand.
Repurchase transactions accounted for 53 per cent of total turnover, up from 52 percent in March.
